description: Convert a mojo amount to its current fiat (or other CoinGecko-supported currency) value. 1 XCH = 1,000,000,000,000 mojo — convert XCH to mojo before calling. Prices come from CoinGecko (cached 60s). Returned values use JS floating-point; precise to far more decimals than any realistic balance.

currencies.description: Fiat or crypto currency codes accepted by CoinGecko (e.g. 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp', 'jpy', 'btc', 'eth'). Case-insensitive. Defaults to ['usd'].

mojo.description: Non-negative integer mojo amount as a decimal string. 1 XCH = 1,000,000,000,000 mojo. Convert XCH amounts to mojo before passing.

name: convert_xch_to_fiat
